name: Input
description:
A single-line text field, with optional start/end adornments and a clear button.

  Input(type: "email", placeholder: "you@example.com", aria_label: "Email")
  Input(variant: :soft, size: :sm, start_slot: :search, clearable: true)
  Input(start_slot: :mail, end_slot: "@example.com")
  Input(end_slot: -> { Button(variant: :ghost, size: :sm, icon: true) { Icon(:eye) } })

Native attributes (type, name, value, required, aria_*) go to the <input>. With a slot or `clearable:` the input sits in a wrapper that carries `class:`; `input:` then passes attributes to the inner <input>. `invalid: true` (or aria_invalid) paints the error state. Inside a Field it takes the field's id, labelling, disabled and invalid state.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Input(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  Input(placeholder:, variant:, size:, clearable:, disabled:, **given(clear_label:), start_slot: (:search if start_icon), end_slot: (:at if end_icon), aria_label: "Playground", class: "max-w-70")
end

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes: `variant:` - a bordered outline (default) or a filled soft field.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    Input(variant: :outline, placeholder: "Outline", aria_label: "Outline")
    Input(variant: :soft, placeholder: "Soft", aria_label: "Soft")
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    { sm: "Small", md: "Medium", lg: "Large" }.each { |size, label| Input(size:, placeholder: label, aria_label: label) }
  end
end

examples.name: Start & end slots
examples.notes: A slot takes an icon name, text, or a block - here an Avatar and a password-visibility Button.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    Input(start_slot: :mail, end_slot: -> { span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-sm") { "@example.com" } }, placeholder: "yourname", aria_label: "Email username")
    Input(start_slot: -> { Avatar(size: :"2xs") { AvatarFallback { Icon(:user_filled) } } }, placeholder: "Display name", aria_label: "Display name")
    Input(type: "password", value: "hidden@password", start_slot: :lock, aria_label: "Password", data: { demo: "password" },
      end_slot: -> { Button(variant: :ghost, size: :sm, icon: true, aria_label: "Show password", class: "-me-1.5", data: { demo: "reveal" }) { Icon(:eye) } })
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const button = document.querySelector("[data-demo=reveal]")
      const input = document.querySelector("[data-demo=password]")
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const show = input.type === "password"
        input.type = show ? "text" : "password"
        button.setAttribute("aria-label", show ? "Hide password" : "Show password")
        button.querySelector("svg").outerHTML = show ? #{UI::Icon.new(:eye_off).call.to_json} : #{UI::Icon.new(:eye).call.to_json}
      })
    JS
  end
end

examples.name: Clearable
examples.notes: `clearable: true` adds a ✕ once the field has a value; it empties the field and fires `input`.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Input(clearable: true, start_slot: :search, value: "Wireless headphones", aria_label: "Search products", class: "max-w-70")
end

examples.name: Disabled, read-only & error states
examples.notes: `invalid: true` (or aria_invalid) paints the error state; inside a Field the field sets it.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    Input(placeholder: "Disabled", disabled: true, aria_label: "Disabled")
    Input(value: "Read-only value", readonly: true, aria_label: "Read-only")
    Input(value: "Input with error", invalid: true, aria_label: "Input with error")
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: The text aligns to the start edge and the adornments swap sides.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl", class: "w-full max-w-70") do
    Input(start_slot: :search, clearable: true, value: "سماعات لاسلكية", placeholder: "ابحث عن منتج", aria_label: "بحث")
  end
end
